name: After § 6
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the implementation of the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive (UWWTD) and risks to the security of supply of medicines
part_text: 6a. Calls on the Commission to make progress on the adoption of implementing acts on the scope of obligations relating to quaternary treatment, to give clarity to the Member States, wastewater operators and relevant stakeholders with regard to the associated costs;
